description: This file defines a wrapper class for GLib functions, including an interface class `GLibWrapsImpl` with pure virtual methods for GLib operations, and a singleton-like class `GLibWraps` that provides static access to these operations, along with some external function declarations for C compatibility.

classes.name: GLibWrapsImpl
classes.description: Abstract interface class providing virtual methods to interact with GLib functionalities, allowing for mocking or custom implementations.

classes.name: GLibWraps
classes.description: Singleton-like wrapper providing static methods to interact with GLib, utilizing a `GLibWrapsImpl` implementation.

methods.name: setImpl
methods.description: Sets the implementation instance for the `GLibWraps` class, allowing dependency injection.

methods.name: g_main_loop_is_running
methods.description: Checks if a given GMainLoop is currently running.

methods.name: g_signal_connect_data
methods.description: Connects a signal handler to a GObject instance with optional data and destroy callback.

methods.name: signal_handlers_disconnect_by_data
methods.description: Disconnects signal handlers associated with a specific data pointer.

methods.name: signal_handlers_disconnect_by_func
methods.description: Disconnects signal handlers associated with a specific callback function.
